item.title: Major work in South Yorkshire means changes to train services to London
item.description: Network Rail is reminding passengers travelling through Sheffield this weekend (7-8 March) to plan ahead of travel, as major engineering work takes place to rebuild a railway bridge.

item.title: Direct Rail Services announces 2026 open day
item.description: Direct Rail Services (DRS) has confirmed that its much-anticipated open day will be returning later this year, welcoming visitors to a special behind-the-scenes experience at one of the UK's leading rail freight operators.

item.title: Northern to improve disability support for passengers
item.description: Passengers who need assistance on Northern Trains can expect better service in the coming months. The Office of Rail and Road (ORR) has secured commitments from the operator to provide disability awareness training for front-line staff and to implement a £550,000 package of additional improvements.

item.title: Bedfordshire Narrow Gauge Railway’s season begins this Easter
item.description: The Toddington Narrow Gauge Railway has announced that its 2026 public running season will begin on Easter Sunday, 5 April, with JUSTINE set to operate, subject to availability.

item.title: Dapol Salt Vans to Launch this Spring
item.description: Dapol to release pitched roof Salt Vans this May

item.title: Coffeepot steam locomotive to haul trains for first time at Gloucestershire railway
item.description: The Gloucestershire Warwickshire Railway have announced a guest that will attend their Cotswold Festival of Steam Gala.

item.title: Vintage treasure uncovered during renewal work on the Tyne and Wear Metro
item.description: Vintage recordings of The Hobbit (1937) by J.R.R Tolkien have been unexpectedly uncovered on a Tyne and Wear Metro line in Newcastle upon Tyne. The discovery occurred during routine track renewal work when maintenance crews came across a set of cassette tapes buried at the base of an overhead line mast.

item.title: Wiltshire station’s £2.3 million upgrade complete
item.description: Great Western Railway has completed a £2.3 million transformation of Chippenham station, creating a modern, accessible hub for passengers, cyclists, and the local community.

item.title: Transport for London unveils a new art map of underground masterpieces
item.description: Transport for London (TfL) has released an updated edition of its free Art Map, showcasing new permanent commissions across the network since 2016.

item.title: Hull Trains and Hull & East Yorkshire Centre for the Deaf create short film on hearing loss
item.description: To mark World Hearing Day on 3 March 2026, Hull Trains has partnered with Hull & East Yorkshire Centre for the Deaf to launch a powerful short film promoting empathy and inclusion for people living with hearing loss.
